(2) A tracked-tree textual sweep via git grep for each candidate id and filename stem. (3) A textual sweep across ALL 263 REACHABLE REFS (local heads plus remotes), not merely the working tree. F_CU_1_ADJUDICATION.why_this_section_exists: LANE CU measured a defect that made the ORIGINALLY SPECIFIED refusal-subject contract mechanically unsatisfiable, and STOPPED rather than materialize it. The HPO adjudication that followed CHANGED the contract. This section preserves both the finding and the adjudication in the authority history, so that a future reader sees WHY the frozen contract has two shapes instead of one, rather than finding a two-shape contract with no recorded cause. Silently rewriting the original assumption is prohibited.
F_CU_1_ADJUDICATION.F_CU_1_STATEMENT: The originally specified contract froze, for BOTH refusal verbs, entity_type='organization' AND entity_id = the attempted organization UUID, while ALSO authorising the reason value TENANCY_NO_ORGANIZATION_SELECTED. Those three cannot hold simultaneously.

F_CU_1_MEASURED_PROOF.1_entity_id_is_NOT_NULL: MEASURED AT THREE INDEPENDENT LAYERS, all agreeing. db/baseline/stella_g2_schema.sql:3823 declares `entity_id uuid NOT NULL` inside CREATE TABLE public.audit_logs. db/schema.ts:95 declares `entityId: uuid('entity_id').notNull()`. And NO migration relaxes it: the only audit_logs DDL in db/migrations/ is the two foreign keys in 0000_quick_husk.sql, ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY in 0031_rls_core.sql, and the project_id FK in 0043_fib_audit_project_id_fk.sql. There is no ALTER COLUMN ... DROP NOT NULL anywhere.
F_CU_1_MEASURED_PROOF.2_the_no_selection_branches_have_no_UUID: MEASURED IN THE INTEGRATED S3 CORE. The reason TENANCY_NO_ORGANIZATION_SELECTED arises at exactly two boundaries, and NEITHER has an organization UUID available. (a) The selector app/(authenticated)/app/organizations/select/actions.ts refuses with error=missing_organization when the submitted organizationId is absent or empty after trim. (b) lib/auth/database-context.ts:402 returns organizationRefusalCode TENANCY_NO_ORGANIZATION_SELECTED when getSelectedOrganizationId() returns null - and lib/auth/selected-organization.ts returns null for BOTH an absent cookie AND a present-but-malformed value, via `if (!value || !UUID_PATTERN.test(value)) return null`.
F_CU_1_MEASURED_PROOF.3_the_additive_policy_does_not_fix_it: The LANE CK/CK-R2 finding F-1 concerned the audit_logs INSERT POLICY rejecting the row because it demands organization membership. The additive policy frozen below discharges F-1. But entity_id NOT NULL is a COLUMN constraint, not a policy predicate: no RLS policy can satisfy it, because a policy filters candidate rows and this row cannot be CONSTRUCTED in the first place. F-CU-1 is therefore a SECOND, INDEPENDENT obstacle that the CK/CK-R2 compilation did not measure.
F_CU_1_MEASURED_PROOF.why_this_was_not_caught_earlier: v1.0.23's AUDIT_VERB_DISPOSITION.measured_reason correctly identified the INSERT-policy obstacle and correctly deferred the verbs. It did not examine the audit_logs COLUMN constraints, because under S3 core the verbs were not being emitted at all. The obstacle only becomes reachable at the moment a successor node tries to construct the row.

REJECTED_RESOLUTIONS.binding: Each of the following was considered and REJECTED by the adjudication. Each is a STOP for the implementation, and each is named because it is a plausible and tempting way to make the problem disappear.
REJECTED_RESOLUTIONS.relax_entity_id_NOT_NULL: REJECTED. An ALTER COLUMN ... DROP NOT NULL on a shared audit table changes the shape of EVERY audit row ever written, not merely the refusal rows, and moves frozen G2 baseline surfaces this addendum prohibits touching. It is far beyond 'one additive INSERT policy'.
REJECTED_RESOLUTIONS.sentinel_organization_uuid: REJECTED. A sentinel such as the nil UUID invents an organization identity that does not exist, makes entity_id something other than descriptive subject metadata, and would be indistinguishable in the trail from a real organization with that id.
REJECTED_RESOLUTIONS.mislabel_the_user_subject_as_an_organiza: REJECTED. Writing entity_type='organization' for a refusal that names no organization records a falsehood in the audit trail. The trail's value is that its subject field is true.
REJECTED_RESOLUTIONS.emit_only_the_NOT_A_MEMBER_reason: REJECTED. It silently DISCARDS half of an obligation that v1.0.23 marked WAIVED=false and OPTIONAL=false. A deferred obligation is not closed by narrowing the successor node until the hard half falls outside it.

F_CU_1_ADJUDICATION.ADJUDICATED_RESOLUTION: TWO-SHAPE REFUSAL AUDIT SUBJECT CONTRACT. The audit row MUST truthfully identify the subject that ACTUALLY EXISTS at the refusal boundary. Where a valid organization UUID assertion exists, the subject is that organization. Where none exists, the subject is the authenticated user. Both refusal reasons are retained exactly; neither obligation is discarded; the audit schema is not widened. F-CU-1 is resolved by TRUTHFUL SUBJECT TYPING, not by widening the audit schema.
F_CU_1_ADJUDICATION.STATUS: BINDING AND NOT REOPENED BY THE IMPLEMENTATION. The adjudication was made before this addendum was written; this addendum RECORDS and MECHANISES it and does not re-litigate it.

REFUSAL_SUBJECT_CONTRACT.binding: EXACTLY TWO forms are authorised. A refusal audit row that matches neither form is a STOP, and the RLS policy frozen below is shaped so that the database itself refuses it.
REFUSAL_SUBJECT_CONTRACT.governing_definition: TENANCY_NO_ORGANIZATION_SELECTED means NO VALID ORGANIZATION UUID ASSERTION EXISTS AT THIS REFUSAL BOUNDARY. It does NOT mean 'the user did not click anything'. Absent, empty, malformed and otherwise-unusable assertions are ALL the same case, and they are all FORM A.

FORM_A.name: NO VALID ORGANIZATION ASSERTION
FORM_A.applies_when: No valid organization UUID assertion exists at the refusal boundary: the assertion is absent, empty, malformed / non-UUID, or otherwise unavailable as a valid organization UUID.
FORM_A.do_not_manufacture_a_subject: BINDING. Do NOT manufacture an organization subject merely because hostile or malformed input contained arbitrary bytes. The bytes are not an organization, and recording them as one would both lie and create a write-anything channel into entity_id.

FORM_B.name: VALID ORGANIZATION UUID, MEMBERSHIP REFUSED
FORM_B.applies_when: A VALID organization UUID assertion exists, but the authenticated subject does not hold the required active membership in it.
FORM_B.entity_id: the exact valid attempted/selected organization UUID
FORM_B.no_existence_lookup: BINDING. No organization existence lookup may be added merely to emit this event. A deleted or nonexistent organization carrying a valid UUID remains OBSERVATIONALLY INDISTINGUISHABLE from ordinary non-membership - which is exactly the property v1.0.23's S3-4 established and which this node must not undo.
FORM_B.why_organization_id_is_still_NULL_in_FOR: The row is an event ABOUT the attempted organization, never an event OWNED by that tenant. Setting organization_id would assert a tenancy relationship the refusal exists to deny, would require membership in the refused organization to write, and would make the row readable by that organization's members. entity_id is DESCRIPTIVE SUBJECT METADATA ONLY.

ACTION_SEMANTICS.forms_are_orthogonal_to_actions: BOTH actions may legitimately occur with EITHER form, depending on whether a valid organization UUID assertion exists at that action's own boundary. The action names WHERE the refusal happened; the form names WHAT the subject was. They are independent axes and the policy must not couple them.
ACTION_SEMANTICS.measured_boundary_mapping: MEASURED IN THE INTEGRATED S3 CORE, recorded so the implementation does not have to re-derive it. tenancy.organization.selection_refused fires at app/(authenticated)/app/organizations/select/actions.ts: its missing_organization branch is FORM A; its not_a_member branch is FORM B when the submitted value is a valid UUID and FORM A when it is not. tenancy.membership.revalidation_refused fires at lib/auth/database-context.ts: the selectedOrganizationId===null path (:402) is FORM A, and the absent-membership path (:414) is FORM B, because getSelectedOrganizationId() has ALREADY guaranteed UUID validity for anything it returns non-null.
ACTION_SEMANTICS.no_new_reasons: BINDING. Do NOT create additional refusal reasons merely to distinguish malformed input from absent input. The two reason values are exhaustive by adjudication.
ACTION_SEMANTICS.no_user_visible_change: BINDING. This is an AUDIT CLASSIFICATION contract. It does NOT authorise changing user-visible selection or refusal semantics, and it is NOT permission to reopen S3 core.

MALFORMED_ASSERTION_DISPOSITION.why_this_edge_needs_explicit_authority: MEASURED: the selector obtains `const requestedOrganizationId = (formData.get('organizationId') as string | null)?.trim()` and then tests membership by comparing that raw string against the enumerated candidates' organization.id. A malformed non-UUID string therefore reaches the not_a_member REFUSAL BRANCH without ever having been UUID-validated. Left unaddressed, an implementation would naturally place that raw string into entity_id - which is both a type error against uuid NOT NULL and an injection of attacker-controlled bytes into the audit trail.
MALFORMED_ASSERTION_DISPOSITION.binding: The implementation MUST classify the audit subject by VALID-UUID-ASSERTION, not by which redirect branch it happens to be in. A malformed organization input is FORM A.
prohibitions: MUST NOT put a malformed string into audit_logs.entity_id
MUST NOT echo the raw malformed value into any audit metadata field, including reason, before_json and after_json
MUST NOT change the carrier-write authorization contract or the user-visible refusal branch the selector takes
MUST NOT introduce a new refusal reason for the malformed case

UUID_SHAPE_MECHANISM.requirement: If the implementation requires a local UUID-shape helper it must use an existing governed mechanism if one exists, and must not authorize a new schema or a broad validation subsystem.
UUID_SHAPE_MECHANISM.MEASURED_STATE_OF_THE_REPOSITORY: There is NO exported UUID-shape helper in the auth layer. `UUID_PATTERN` exists as a MODULE-PRIVATE const in FOUR modules - lib/auth/identity.ts:78, lib/auth/selected-organization.ts:79, lib/auth/session.ts:54 and db/identity-context.ts:88 - and all four literals are BYTE-IDENTICAL: /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i . None of the four is exported. The zod `z.string().uuid()` occurrences in lib/admin/** and lib/pipeline/** are a domain-input-validation convention in service modules, not the auth-layer convention.
UUID_SHAPE_MECHANISM.AUTHORIZED_FORM: The existing governed mechanism IS that four-fold convention. lib/audit/tenancy-refusal.ts - a NEW file already inside the ceiling - declares its OWN module-private UUID_PATTERN byte-identical to the established literal, becoming a fifth instance of an existing convention.
UUID_SHAPE_MECHANISM.WHY_NOT_EXPORT_THE_EXISTING_ONE: MEASURED CEILING CONSEQUENCE, not stylistic preference. All four host modules - lib/auth/identity.ts, lib/auth/selected-organization.ts, lib/auth/session.ts and db/identity-context.ts - are OUTSIDE the 17-path ceiling. Exporting from any of them would require an EIGHTEENTH path and fail the ceiling closed. Declaring the constant inside a file the ceiling already contains is the only form that requires no additional implementation path, which is why the adjudication's 'requires NO additional implementation path' holds.
UUID_SHAPE_MECHANISM.prohibited: Refactoring the four existing literals into a shared exported helper is a STOP in this node. It is a defensible cleanup and it is somebody else's authorized mission.

AUDIT_LOG_POLICY_CONTRACT.binding: ONE additive INSERT policy on public.audit_logs. It is a NARROW INSERT-SHAPE WALL, never an organization oracle.
AUDIT_LOG_POLICY_CONTRACT.additive_not_replacing: BINDING. The existing audit_logs_insert_member_or_admin policy is BYTE-UNCHANGED. This policy is ADDED beside it. Widening the old generic policy is a STOP.
AUDIT_LOG_POLICY_CONTRACT.semantic_shape: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "audit_logs_insert_tenancy_refusal" ON audit_logs; CREATE POLICY "audit_logs_insert_tenancy_refusal" ON audit_logs FOR INSERT TO uellix_app WITH CHECK ( actor_user_id = auth.uid() AND organization_id IS NULL AND project_id IS NULL AND action IN ('tenancy.organization.selection_refused','tenancy.membership.revalidation_refused') AND before_json IS NULL AND after_json IS NULL AND ip_address IS NULL AND user_agent IS NULL AND ( (reason = 'TENANCY_NO_ORGANIZATION_SELECTED' AND entity_type = 'user' AND entity_id = auth.uid()) OR (reason = 'TENANCY_SELECTED_ORGANIZATION_NOT_A_MEMBER' AND entity_type = 'organization' AND entity_id IS NOT NULL) ) );
AUDIT_LOG_POLICY_CONTRACT.semantic_guidance_only: The SQL above is SEMANTIC GUIDANCE, not permission to implement in this lane, and not a byte-exact mandate. The implementation must satisfy the INVARIANTS below; exact formatting, the DROP-then-CREATE idiom and statement ordering follow the repository's existing migration conventions.

exactly_one_subject_form_required.FORM_A_disjunct: reason = 'TENANCY_NO_ORGANIZATION_SELECTED' AND entity_type = 'user' AND entity_id = auth.uid()
exactly_one_subject_form_required.FORM_B_disjunct: reason = 'TENANCY_SELECTED_ORGANIZATION_NOT_A_MEMBER' AND entity_type = 'organization' AND entity_id IS NOT NULL
exactly_one_subject_form_required.why_the_disjunction_is_inside_the_policy: Because the correlation is the whole point. A policy that merely allowed reason IN (both) AND entity_type IN (both) would accept the CROSS PRODUCT - a FORM A row wearing entity_type='organization', or a FORM B row whose entity_id is the caller's own user id. Those are precisely the two forgeries RA-SUBJECT-5 and RA-SUBJECT-7 exist to catch, and the database must refuse them without relying on the emitter being correct.
exactly_one_subject_form_required.entity_id_NOT_NULL_is_restated_deliberat: entity_id IS NOT NULL in the FORM B disjunct is redundant against the column constraint and is stated anyway, so the policy remains self-describing if it is ever read apart from the table definition.

what_the_database_CANNOT_prove.binding: DISCLOSED, NOT PAPERED OVER. The policy can prove that a FORM B row carries SOME valid non-null uuid in entity_id. It CANNOT prove that this uuid is THE organization the subject actually attempted, because proving that would require the very organizations-table lookup this contract forbids.
what_the_database_CANNOT_prove.consequence: The 'entity_id equals the actual attempted UUID' obligation is an APPLICATION-LEVEL oracle, discharged by control RA-SUBJECT-8, not by the policy. An implementation that claims the policy proves it is wrong.
what_the_database_CANNOT_prove.why_the_lookup_stays_forbidden: An existence check against public.organizations inside an INSERT policy would turn every refusal write into an organization-existence oracle for an unauthenticated-in-that-tenant subject - reintroducing exactly the leak FORM B's no_existence_lookup clause and v1.0.23's S3-4 both close.

PROHIBITED.binding: Each of the following is a STOP.
list: widening or altering the existing audit_logs_insert_member_or_admin policy
any change to the SELECT policy audit_logs_select_member_or_admin
service-role or any other privileged connection
RLS bypass of any form, including SET ROLE or a BYPASSRLS role
a new table, a new schema, a new function, a new enum or a new foreign key
an organizations-table existence lookup inside the policy

READABILITY_CONTRACT.binding: NULL-org refusal audit rows - BOTH FORM A and FORM B - are readable ONLY by superadmin under the current governed audit model. No ordinary organization member gains read access to them.
READABILITY_CONTRACT.NO_SELECT_POLICY_CHANGE_AUTHORIZED: BINDING. The required behaviour ALREADY HOLDS and must be frozen, not implemented.
READABILITY_CONTRACT.measured_proof: MEASURED at INTEGRATION_SHA, db/baseline/stella_g2_schema.sql:8829: `CREATE POLICY audit_logs_select_member_or_admin ON public.audit_logs FOR SELECT USING (((organization_id = ANY (public.current_user_org_ids())) OR public.current_user_is_super_admin()))`. With organization_id NULL, the expression `NULL = ANY (...)` evaluates to NULL - never TRUE - so the row fails the member arm for EVERY member, including members of the organization named in a FORM B entity_id. Only the current_user_is_super_admin() arm can admit it. The readability contract is therefore a CONSEQUENCE of the existing policy plus organization_id IS NULL, not a new grant.
READABILITY_CONTRACT.no_membership_conferred_by_entity_id: BINDING. entity_id is DESCRIPTIVE SUBJECT METADATA ONLY. No membership, no read grant and no tenancy relationship may be inferred from it by any consumer. No FK from entity_id to organizations is introduced, and none may be.
READABILITY_CONTRACT.no_existence_oracle: The refusal row is not readable by the party who could use it as an oracle. A subject who is refused cannot read the row their own refusal produced, because they are not a superadmin and the row carries no organization_id that could admit them.

S3_REFUSAL_AUDIT_NODE_IDENTITY.purpose: Make the already-governed S3 refusal events auditable WITHOUT widening ordinary tenant read or write authority.
S3_REFUSAL_AUDIT_NODE_IDENTITY.discharges: The DEFERRED_VERBS obligation frozen by ODS_V1_MAINTENANCE_ADDENDUM_v1.0.23.json AUDIT_VERB_DISPOSITION and by MULTI_ORG_S1_S2_EXECUTION_SCOPE_AUTHORITY_AMENDMENT_v1.0.4.json AUDIT_VERB_DISPOSITION.

DEFERRED_VERBS_INHERITED.conversion: This authority converts them from DEFERRED OBLIGATION into GOVERNED IMPLEMENTATION SCOPE. Both are discharged in full; neither is narrowed.

PROHIBITIONS_INHERITED_FROM_v1_0_23_ARE_.why_this_clause_is_load_bearing: ODS_V1_MAINTENANCE_ADDENDUM_v1.0.23.json AUDIT_VERB_DISPOSITION.PROHIBITED_WORKAROUNDS lists, among others, 'a new or altered audit_logs policy' and 'emitting the verb with a NULL organization_id to sidestep the predicate'. Read without scope, those two clauses would forbid EXACTLY what this node does, and a future auditor comparing the two artefacts would read a direct contradiction.
PROHIBITIONS_INHERITED_FROM_v1_0_23_ARE_.the_scoping: Those prohibitions bind S3 CORE, which had no authority to add a policy and would therefore have been SIDESTEPPING the existing predicate. This node is the NAMED SUCCESSOR that v1.0.23 AUDIT_VERB_DISPOSITION.successor_node points to, and it acts under its OWN governed authority: it ADDS a narrow policy under an explicit protected grant and a migration, rather than evading the existing one.
PROHIBITIONS_INHERITED_FROM_v1_0_23_ARE_.the_material_difference: A SIDESTEP reaches the same table by a route that avoids the governing predicate. This node does not avoid the predicate - it leaves audit_logs_insert_member_or_admin BYTE-UNCHANGED and adds a second, narrower permissive policy whose WITH CHECK admits exactly two row shapes and nothing else. The generic write path is not widened by one row.
PROHIBITIONS_INHERITED_FROM_v1_0_23_ARE_.honest_disclosure_of_the_consequence: DISCLOSED. PostgreSQL combines multiple PERMISSIVE policies for the same command with OR. Adding this policy therefore DOES enlarge the set of rows uellix_app can insert into audit_logs - that is what an additive policy is. The enlargement is bounded to rows satisfying every common invariant AND exactly one subject form, all with organization_id IS NULL and actor_user_id = auth.uid(). Claiming the surface is unchanged would be false; the claim made here is that the enlargement is exactly the two adjudicated refusal shapes and is separately proven so by RA-SUBJECT-3 through RA-SUBJECT-8.
PROHIBITIONS_INHERITED_FROM_v1_0_23_ARE_.the_other_four_prohibitions_remain_absol: service-role or any privileged connection, RLS bypass in any form, SECURITY DEFINER, and writing the refusal to a different table remain STOPS for THIS node exactly as they were for S3 core. They are re-stated in AUDIT_LOG_POLICY_CONTRACT.PROHIBITED.

MIGRATION_DISPOSITION.binding: A PostgreSQL RLS policy is ADDED, and in this repository a policy reaches the database only through the governed migration chain plus its prepared journal wrapper. That is why four protected paths and a protected grant exist for this node at all, and it is the single structural difference between this node and S3 core (which required none).
MIGRATION_DISPOSITION.what_the_migration_contains: EXACTLY the additive audit_logs_insert_tenancy_refusal policy frozen in AUDIT_LOG_POLICY_CONTRACT, in the repository's established DROP POLICY IF EXISTS then CREATE POLICY idiom - the same shape db/migrations/0042_fib_audit_insert_policy.sql already uses for the sibling policy. NO table, NO column, NO index, NO function, NO enum, NO foreign key and NO second policy.
MIGRATION_DISPOSITION.ordinal_rule: The implementation MUST derive the NEXT FREE migration ordinal at implementation start, from the live db/migrations/ listing AND db/migrations/meta/_journal.json AND db/prepared/journal/ together. MIGRATION_DISPOSITION.collision_hazard: The ordinal sequence is globally serialized across every lane. Two lanes that both assume the ordinal they measured will collide in db/migrations/meta/_journal.json, which is a shared append point and is itself one of the four protected paths.

No third policy exists at this SHA.
POLICY_PROBE_CONTRACT.probe_must_assert_both: The probe must assert BOTH policy PRESENCE (the three names above, by name, on this table) AND refusal SEMANTICS (that the two authorised shapes insert and the forgeries do not). Presence alone would pass against a policy whose WITH CHECK had been gutted.

TEST_AND_MUTATION_CONTRACT.binding: Real-PostgreSQL and DB-free controls are BOTH required. A control that only exists as prose in an evidence artifact is not a control.
BASE_CONTROLS: a legitimate selection refusal can be inserted
a membership-revalidation refusal can be inserted
only the two authorized actions are accepted
only the two authorized reasons are accepted
before_json and after_json must be NULL
ip_address and user_agent must be NULL

no membership is conferred by entity_id

ADJUDICATION_CONTROLS.note: These NINE plus one are required IN ADDITION to the base controls, and exist specifically because of the F-CU-1 two-shape adjudication. They are named by id so the implementation's evidence artifact can bind to them without restating them.
ADJUDICATION_CONTROLS.RA-SUBJECT-1: NO valid organization assertion at the boundary yields entity_type='user' AND entity_id=auth.uid() (FORM A accepted).
ADJUDICATION_CONTROLS.RA-SUBJECT-2: A valid organization UUID with no active membership yields entity_type='organization' AND entity_id = that attempted UUID (FORM B accepted).
ADJUDICATION_CONTROLS.RA-SUBJECT-3: Malformed organization input MUST NEVER be stored as entity_id, MUST classify as FORM A, and MUST NOT leak the raw malformed bytes into any field of the row.
ADJUDICATION_CONTROLS.RA-SUBJECT-4: A sentinel organization UUID is PROHIBITED - a FORM B row whose entity_id is the nil UUID or any other manufactured constant must be rejected by the application-level oracle.
ADJUDICATION_CONTROLS.RA-SUBJECT-5: FORM A carrying entity_type='organization' MUST FAIL (database-level: the policy's disjunction refuses it).
ADJUDICATION_CONTROLS.RA-SUBJECT-6: FORM A whose entity_id != auth.uid() MUST FAIL (database-level).
ADJUDICATION_CONTROLS.RA-SUBJECT-7: FORM B carrying entity_type='user' MUST FAIL (database-level).
ADJUDICATION_CONTROLS.RA-SUBJECT-8: FORM B emitted with a DIFFERENT valid UUID than the actual attempted valid UUID MUST FAIL the APPLICATION-LEVEL oracle.
